title: Space Bunny Free (OpenCode Zen)
notes: Stealth preview reasoning model. Served over /v1/chat/completions (openai-compatible), which is the weaker cache dialect compared with models on /v1/responses. At the time of writing it is the only free model on Zen whose top reasoning effort is `max` and whose provider is zero-retention. Free for a limited time; expect the slot to rotate.
